authorization.scope: one Research Program v2 epoch with at most four ordered D3 rounds

design_authority.assignment_rule: zip proposal mechanism source order to ascending supported single-timeframe duration; this is an implementation-simplicity rule fixed without prior outcomes

broker_binding.swap: separate directional points; Wednesday triple; server-midnight cutover remains modeled assumption

notebook_binding.definition_extractor: canonical JSON of cell_index plus ast.dump(include_attributes=False) for top-level FunctionDef, AsyncFunctionDef, and ClassDef nodes in code cells; imports, calls, markdown, metadata, and outputs excluded; never execute

rounds.assignment_rationale: The one-previous-bar price-structure comparison has the shortest dependency and is assigned first to the shortest supported duration by implementation simplicity only.

data_prefix.identity: D1 must authenticate one bounded read with exact raw and canonical hashes, row indices, timestamps, timezone, dtypes, and complete prefix endpoint before D2 or D3

signal.no_signal: otherwise; also no signal for nonfinite dependencies or invalid OHLC
signal.symmetry: replace price with its sign-inverted series and swap high/low to exchange long and short
signal.equality: strict comparisons; equality is no signal

rounds.assignment_rationale: The fixed 20-bar mean adds one rolling regime dependency and is assigned second to the next supported duration by implementation simplicity only.

data_prefix.identity: D1 must authenticate one bounded read with exact raw and canonical hashes, row indices, timestamps, timezone, dtypes, and complete prefix endpoint before D2 or D3

signal.definition: sma20[t] = arithmetic mean(close[t-19:t+1]) over exactly 20 finite fully closed bars
signal.no_signal: otherwise; also no signal for any nonfinite dependency
signal.symmetry: sign inversion of every close exchanges long and short
signal.equality: strict comparisons; equality in either clause is no signal

rounds.assignment_rationale: The prior-14-TR reference adds a second rolling state and is assigned third to the next supported duration by implementation simplicity only.

data_prefix.identity: D1 must authenticate one bounded read with exact raw and canonical hashes, row indices, timestamps, timezone, dtypes, and complete prefix endpoint before D2 or D3

signal.definition: TR[i] = max(high[i]-low[i], abs(high[i]-close[i-1]), abs(low[i]-close[i-1])) for i>=1; reference_atr14[t] = arithmetic mean(TR[t-14:t]) using exactly the 14 TR values strictly before t
signal.no_signal: otherwise; also no signal for nonfinite dependencies, invalid OHLC, or reference_atr14[t] <= 0
signal.symmetry: sign inversion with high/low swapped exchanges long and short while preserving TR and abstention
signal.equality: shock-threshold equality abstains; open/close equality is no signal

rounds.assignment_rationale: Absolute close displacement versus the largest configured spread multiplier is naturally evaluated on the longest supported duration and is assigned fourth without outcome evidence.

data_prefix.identity: D1 must authenticate one bounded read with exact raw and canonical hashes, row indices, timestamps, timezone, dtypes, and complete prefix endpoint before D2 or D3

signal.no_signal: otherwise; also no signal for nonfinite dependencies
signal.symmetry: sign inversion of every close exchanges long and short and preserves the positive configured cost threshold
signal.equality: strict comparisons; equality at either threshold is no signal

runtime.signal_scope: single timeframe; only fully closed Bid bars through t
runtime.signal_to_execution: signal at close[t], execute only at next permitted bar t+1 open: long Ask; short Bid
runtime.exits: ATR14 stop and RR target; conservative same-bar stop-first; forced final close
runtime.costs: authoritative baseline and stress spreads; separate directional swap with Wednesday triple; zero commission and fee
runtime.accounting: realized cash plus floating marked equity; peak-equity drawdown fraction

d1_data_derivation_rule.authority: the round's exact single-timeframe path and header-plus-5000-row prefix; D1 must independently authenticate before any execution
d1_data_derivation_rule.requirements: exactly three chronological folds; each train/test contiguous, immediate, non-overlapping; reject missing rows, gaps, duplicates, reorder, overlap, off-by-one, path/timestamp/timezone/dtype/hash drift, or post-outcome change

d3_evaluation_counts.test_policy: immediate unranked TEST after freezing each fold identity; TEST may only decide terminal strict pass/fail

d3_gates.selection: TRAIN only: adequate iff at least one completed trade at every TRAIN spread; maximize worst-spread TRAIN net PnL, minimize worst TRAIN drawdown fraction, then source order; freeze identity only for immediate unranked TEST
d3_gates.terminal: strict failure => NO_FREEZE_CANDIDATE; strict pass => FREEZE_READY and stop for explicit user decision

stop_rules: stop before D1 unless this D0 ends independent AUDIT: PASS
stop on any agenda, proposal, source, broker, notebook-definition, data-prefix, chronology, accounting, or report-identity mismatch; do not salvage a candidate
stop each round before D3 unless its D1 and D2 each end independent AUDIT: PASS
FREEZE_READY stops the program immediately for a new explicit user decision; no automatic holdout, forward, operational freeze, promotion, MQL5, or deployment
NO_FREEZE_CANDIDATE may continue only to the next predeclared round without TEST-driven formula, threshold, candidate, risk, order, or timeframe repair
stop after four D3 rounds or one v2 epoch, whichever comes first; no automatic second v2 epoch

stop immediately on holdout, forward, full-sample fallback, cross-timeframe selection, external/news/sentiment/ML/RL input, multi-position behavior, risk-envelope change, or TEST-driven generation/tuning/ranking/repair
staged_fail_closed_order: agenda JSON decode plus exact recursive schema and semantic validation
verified broker byte SHA-256 and authoritative constants
notebook definition-only AST identity without execution
